target: PDLLA loss modulus, measured as an orthogonal response to storage-fit prediction
input_availability: Imposed temperature and angular frequency. Parameters fitted on declared storage-only development sweeps, never on the loss target.
independent_groups: whole temperature sweep; one original material batch
baseline_families: Frozen positive Maxwell model fitted to storage response
Frozen fractional viscoelastic model fitted to storage response
exclusions: Report missing or malformed native loss measurements; retain finite signed measurements for physical error; log diagnostics only on positive values

measurement_anchors.locator: ZIP member PDLLA15k_DSC_GPC_rheo/rheology/DFS_gap0.879_T40_smax0.1 and corresponding whole temperature sweep members; loss modulus column in native rheometer tables

scientific_test: Evaluate loss response without fitting its coefficients; test orthogonal complex-modulus consistency. This example proposes contract review only; it does not claim a new finding or automatically enable scores.
source_derived_targets_disclosure: Instrument-reported loss modulus in source-native rheometer output; calibrated instrument measurement, not fitted model prediction.
